cost_calendar: UTC calendar dates inclusive from first evaluation session; weekends accrue; modeled expense not invoice

data_admission.calendar_grid: Every expected5minute RTH slot for all3symbols; no forward fills or synthetic prices
data_admission.corporate_action_dates: process_date filter is not ex_date completeness; preserve all returned types and flags; effective dates conditional, original announcement receipts unknown
data_admission.missing_bar_policy: At most2 targeted recapture attempts per missing interval using samefeed/symbol/time; otherwise DATA_BLOCKED, no invented no-fill
data_admission.prepared_old149_raw_missing: Do not treat retained prepared artifact as reconstruction from original provider receipts; fresh captures must be retained and hashed
data_admission.price_adjustment: Tool has no adjustment parameter; retain documented endpoint raw default as assumption, not certification
data_admission.request_partition: One symbol per calendar month; limit10000; final month ends2026-10-16T23:59:59Z
data_admission.split_knowledge_contract: Explicit observed knownAt required for split-crossing ATR features; absent timestamp causes affected decision refusal, never invent an announcement. Effective-date action book remains conditional historical modeling; report omitted sector events.
data_admission.unexpected_next_page_or_count_at_limit: REJECT_TRUNCATION; narrow interval only, never silently accept incomplete
data_admission.unsupported_affecting_action: Fail closed for unresolved action in study universe/period

data_limitations: SIP original bars retained; availableAt=bar end+1second is modeled, not original received timestamp.
No observed BBO, executable depth, queue position, auctions, implied-volatility context or crypto measurements.
AAPL/MSFT survivors are a fixed retrospective universe; no point-in-time all-listings or liquidity certification.
Dividend rights from retained corporate-action records are accrued economically; publication times are unavailable.

decision.clock: Session open + 60 minutes + 1 second, fill at next five-minute open; every candidate uses same delay.
decision.cost_hurdle: Half positive residual excursion exceeds modeled roundtrip spread + twice slippage + per-share fees + 5bps.
decision.entry_price: Future open only resolves IOC fill, never ranking, features or ex ante sizing.
decision.execution_template: Native CLOSED_CHANNEL BASELINE stops and targets; clock horizons and value exits are explicit additive extensions.
decision.h1_admission: Forecast lower mean bound exceeds the same complete roundtrip modeled hurdle plus 5bps.
decision.h3_value: No repeated entry cost. Exit-versus-hold both incur one eventual sale; equal modeled proportional spread/slip/fee schedules cancel at first order. LCB uncertainty is not a tail-loss guarantee.
decision.ranking: Maximum admissible positive residual z among AAPL/MSFT; ties lexicographically maximum symbol.
decision.stop: ATR14 from completed prior sessions, floor 0.02 USD. Any own-stock split in lookback or campaign is refused.

economic_acceptance.comparability: Same ex ante risk limits. Realized exposure differs and is reported; no risk-equivalent superiority certified.
economic_acceptance.reason: Globally reused history, original receipt timing and real fills absent

entry_model.method: rolling OLS of first60minute stock return on sector return; beta[0,2],sigma>1e-6,z>=1.5; half positive residual excursion exceeds costs+5bp

calibration.scope: Only matured rolling TRAIN; last20 sessions held out from earlier fitting with label maturity purge

forecast.h3_remaining_time: Use CLOCK24 only if its calendar deadline does not exceed original campaign deadline; otherwise abstain and preserve native protection.
forecast.method: ridge lambda10, daily-cluster HAC lag5, mean LCB z1.645
forecast.purge: Each label known_at must be <=fit_asof; same-day future labels excluded
forecast.refit_rule: At first forecast decision at least120elapsed hours after prior fit
forecast.target_units: GROSS_PRICE_LOG_RETURN; dividends accrue only in economic portfolio ledger
forecast.targets: Log return from next executable open to each received-calendar deadline, decomposed into exact intersession overnight gaps and residual intraday return. Fits use identical designs; their sum equals the total fit.
forecast.uncertainty_limit: Daily-cluster HAC mean standard errors are an approximation; ridge bias and finite-sample LCB coverage are not certified.

hypothesis.H1: Clock and horizon conditioning of positive residual continuation.
hypothesis.H2: Volatility-normalized gap acceptance with optional sector confirmation, using the same causal entry delay.
hypothesis.H3: Continuation-value exits with unchanged source entries; paired attribution fixes initial quantities and prices.

risk_contract.cash_dividends: Accrued ex-date rights, payable-date cash; split crossing and missing tape remain core fail-closed contracts
risk_contract.own_stock_split_lookback: Exclude feature or label window crossing an own-stock split without share-unit adjustment; do not fabricate announcement timestamps.

statistics.comparability: Same ex ante caps, exposure differences reported; no risk-matched superior alpha certified.
statistics.endpoint_detail: Two block lengths times (12 candidate-scenario absolute log-growth means + 48 paired candidate-versus-four-fixed-control log-growth differences).
statistics.risk_checks: Observed event drawdown <=8%, close-to-close daily loss <=2%. No tick or real-execution guarantee.

stopping: Exactly six complete recipes and two registered cost scenarios; retain failures; no retuning or posthoc composition
universe_limitations: XLK holds AAPL/MSFT, so benchmark is not independent
Two surviving stocks, not point-in-time all-listings universe
